name: Agent Harness
rationale: Ensures every generated repo has durable instructions and contracts before implementation starts.

sources.label: architect-mcp product rule
sources.note: The project exists to stop chat-only architecture guidance from disappearing between agent runs.

sources.label: local skills source material
sources.note: create-agentsmd, create-llms, remember, mcp-cli, and verification-before-completion provide source material for durable agent instructions, memory scopes, MCP client recipes, and completion honesty.

rules: Commit docs/architecture-contract.md before creating feature files.
Keep editor/agent rules derived from the same contract.
Use pre-edit contracts for vague risky implementation requests.
Disclose applied memory and keep user, project, session, and codebase memory scopes separate.
No final completion claim without stating checks run, skipped, failed, or not run.
reviewQuestions: Will a future agent see the same architecture rules without reading chat history?
Does the implementation contract say what changed, what was verified, which assumptions were made, and what was not done?
Could any remembered preference override the current user request without disclosure?
